Class VirtualizationDetector

java.lang.Object
oshi.util.VirtualizationDetector
@ThreadSafe public final class VirtualizationDetector extends Object
Identifies a virtualized or containerized environment from signatures a hypervisor leaves in hardware information.

The signature tables ship as the oshi.vm.properties and oshi.vmmacaddr.properties resources. Placing a file of either name earlier on the classpath replaces that table wholesale, which is the supported way to teach OSHI about a platform it does not know; note that it replaces rather than merges, so an override loses the built-in entries.

  • Method Details

    • identify

      public static Optional<String> identify(HardwareAbstractionLayer hw)
      Attempts to identify the virtualized or containerized environment this machine is running in.

      Three signatures are tested, and the first to match wins: the hypervisor's CPUID vendor string, the computer system's manufacturer and model, and the OUI of a network interface's MAC address. Where two disagree the earlier one is reported, which for a QEMU guest running under KVM is the normal case rather than an error.

      Parameters:
      hw - The HardwareAbstractionLayer to read signatures from.
      Returns:
      The name of the virtualization platform if one was identified, otherwise an empty Optional. An empty value means no signature matched, which is not proof that the machine is physical.
